end-dead.title: The Lake Keeps You
text: Nobody comes back up the stair.
At The Fort, Maren waits three days. On the fourth she puts the lake chart away. Wick lights the lamps on the wall early, and counts the boats.
The Isle of Old Stone keeps its light. Someone has learned your names.

end-door.title: The Door Stays Shut
text: You do not open the Door. You copy the eyes if you can. You leave.
You row home with what you carry. At The Fort, Maren reads the report twice. The Door under the lake faces north, toward the Deep, and a tired fish is all that guards it, if it still guards it.
What will you do to survive out here? And what will you leave shut?
